a.name: Character A
a.desc: a round orange cartoon fruit hero with big oval eyes, a green leaf on top, muscular arms, a belt and green trousers

traits.q: Are his arms thin or noodle-like instead of big and muscular?
Are his eyes small dots instead of big ovals?
Is he showing a clenched row of separate teeth instead of an open grin?

b.name: Character B
b.desc: a cartoon unicorn girl with a braided mane who wears round purple boxing gloves with yellow stars

traits.q: Does she show bare fingers, a thumb or a hand instead of round boxing gloves?
Does she have a long loose flowing mane instead of a braid?
